notes: robots.txt (200) is permissive: it disallows only /netvolution/, /preview/, /anazitisi/, /frontpages/, /APP/ and advertises 7 sitemap indexes. /sitemap.xml is 404. Route used: https://www.protothema.gr/sitemap/Articles/sitemap_index.xml (200, 153 KB) lists 1901 numbered chunks /sitemap/Articles/<N>.xml, each a flat urlset of ~280-680 <url> with <loc> and <lastmod> (UTC); chunk 1901 = 2026-10-24..10-25, chunk 1884 = 2026-09-22..09-24, so chunks are ordered by article id and therefore by publication order, ~500-650 articles and ~1.5 days per chunk. The script walks chunks from the highest number downwards (18 chunks fetched, 10s at the polite_fetch rate), keeps urls whose lastmod calendar date is inside 2026-09-25..2026-10-25, dedupes, and stops after 2 consecutive chunks whose newest lastmod is before the window (1884, 1883). Date written = the date part of the sitemap <lastmod> exactly as the site states it. Checked /sitemap/NewsArticles/sitemap_index.xml too (83 chunks): it carries news:publication_date, but that field is LOCAL Greek time mislabelled Z (13:35Z where lastmod says 10:35Z), so it would be off by 3 h and is not needed. Result: 10025 unique urls, every day in the window covered, 2026-09-30=374, 2026-10-10=244, 2026-10-20=382, min day 185 (2026-10-17). Verified by re-fetching 26 random articles across the window: 26/26 HTTP 200, 4953-37247 chars of body text (0 thin pages), page date (article:published_time / JSON-LD datePublished) equal to the listed date on 24 and 1 day later on 2 (Kampala/EEST boundary cases), never outside the 1-day tolerance. Run time 10s, output data/urls_custom/protothema-gr.tsv.
